summary: Cleveland/Burke county-line lookout; a tower cabin was built about 1959 for the NC Forest Service, and a visitor's post reports the tower gone.

facts.status_note: One visitor's post suggests the tower was taken down and a radio communications tower took its place; no removal date found.

events.note: A state report for 1958-60 records a tower cabin constructed at Benns Knob; a visitor's post dates the tower to 1959.
Survey description places a survey station about 20 feet north of a North Carolina Forest Service tower.

evidence.supports: A state report for 1958-60 records a tower cabin constructed at Benns Knob on the Cleveland-Burke county line.
evidence.quote: 1958-60: "Tower cabin constructed at Benns Knob on the Cleveland-Burke county line."

evidence.supports: The lookout page names the North Carolina Forest Service as the agency.

evidence.quote: Sites are located at Shelby, City of Kings Mountain, Boiling Springs,Polkville and Benn Knob.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The state report gives a 1958-60 span for the tower cabin and the visitor's post gives 1959. The 1959 date falls inside the span, so the story uses the span and notes the post's date.

sources.title: This video shows the former Benn Knob fire tower location on the Cleveland-Burke County line

notes_for_editor: Brief status was unknown. The gone status rests on one visitor's Facebook post with no removal date. The RadioReference entry shows a radio site named Benn Knob but does not mention a tower removal, so it corroborates only the radio use. The lookout page spells the name Benns Knob; the survey and map files use Benn Knob. Access is left out: the 1975 directions run over a private road and past a gate, but no source gives the present access. No staffing or fire records found in two searches. A call to the NC Forest Service would confirm the removal date.
